description: Wait for the discussion to move past `afterSequence` and return it, rather than polling for it. Returns as soon as anybody — a designer in the browser or another agent — posts, resolves or deletes; returns a `timedOut` reply if nothing happens within `waitSeconds`, which you answer by calling again with the same cursor. This is how you hold a conversation about a design: post, wait, read, act.

afterSequence.description: The `sequence` you last saw. 0 for anything at all.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: ui_builder_await_comments
